newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SHARES END NEAR LOWS AFTER FRESH DOW DIP.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SHARES END NEAR LOWS AFTER FRESH DOW DIP.

text.p: 1550 GMT - Bel-20 index ends 0.81 percent weaker, near intra-day low, after Wall Street encounters fresh losses.
* Players welcome correction, which is likely to be shortlived unless Wall Street nosedives.
* New political scandal over arrest of two francophone socialist party officials not worrying market.
* Retailers GIB and Delhaize among biggest gainers
